title: To The Sky!
description: This is a server featuring Create: Aeronautics!
body:
# Features

### Create
A technical automation mod

### Create: Aeronautics
A Create addon that adds realistic physics based contraptions

### Farmers Delight
A food based mod

### And More!
More mods are installed like Vista, Create: Deco, Create: Copycats+, etc.

# Purpose

To make a fun Create: Aeronautics server not based in EU or something so you dont have insane ping for no reason.

# Optimization

On a 4060, i7-14700K, 32G ram I am able to get 60+ FPS with Voxy and shaders at the same time!
